fluff.overview: The Nuberu Anti-Aircraft Tank was one of the final joint projects between Clan Snow Raven and the Outworlds Alliance prior to the formation of the Raven Alliance. Entering production in 3083 at the United Outworlders Corporation facility on Mitchella, the Nuberu was designed to address the critical shortage of air defense assets plaguing the Alliance's ground forces after the Jihad. With pirate activity surging across the expanded Raven Alliance territories and the Aerospace Arm stretched too thin to provide adequate coverage, Snow Raven engineers partnered with their native Outworlder counterparts to create an improved anti-aircraft platform based on the proven Partisan concept. The collaboration produced a vehicle that costs less than two-thirds of a comparable Partisan Air Defense Tank.
fluff.capabilities:
The Nuberu's most distinctive feature is its innovative twin-turret design, splitting four Clan-grade Type OVR-X LB 5-X autocannons between two independent weapon mounts. This arrangement ensures that if one turret is disabled, the vehicle retains half its firepower and can continue engaging targets. The TRTTS Mark V AirTracker targeting system provides very accurate fire against airborne targets, though it is somewhat inaccurate against ground-based threats and the targeting computer often has problems attempting to track every missile.

Nine and a half tons of Clan laser-reflective armor significantly increase the vehicle's resistance to strafing attacks from energy weapon-armed aerospace fighters, the most deadly threat in the typical operating environment. A Jones ElectroCell 180 fuel cell engine provides a modest 54 km/h top speed, prioritizing affordability and simplicity over the fusion powerplants of more expensive designs. Ammunition endurance is limited, with only two tons of cluster rounds for the four autocannons, but as a defensive vehicle operating close to friendly supply lines, this is not considered a significant liability. The fuel cell engine and Clan manufacturing techniques keep production costs well below fusion-powered equivalents, enabling the Raven Alliance to field them in large numbers.
fluff.deployment: Every Raven Alliance garrison fields at least two platoons of Nuberus, with many possessing a full company. The vehicle's affordable production cost has allowed rapid fielding across the Alliance's dispersed territories, freeing aerospace fighters and BattleMechs from static defensive assignments. Deployment concentrations are heaviest on worlds with significant industrial or military infrastructure.
fluff.history:
The post-Jihad expansion of the Raven Alliance brought security challenges that no amount of Clan martial tradition could resolve through BattleMech deployments alone. With Clan Snow Raven's forces concentrated in their newly captured Draconis Combine holdings and suffering heavy touman losses, many Raven enclaves across the former Outworlds Alliance had been stripped of troops. The Jihad had been kinder to the Alliance than to many other realms, but the erosion of central authority led to a marked increase in pirate bands preying on the scattered, poorly defended worlds. With attacks occurring almost daily, the Alliance Aerospace Arm could no longer serve as the first line of defense, leaving ground forces critically exposed to air attack.

The answer, in the eyes of Snow Raven engineers, was obvious: the Inner Sphere had solved this problem centuries ago with the Partisan Heavy Tank and its descendants. The Raven Alliance needed a vehicle that could provide the same mobile air defense coverage, freeing aerospace fighters and BattleMechs from static defensive assignments. The Ravens initially suggested licensing the Partisan directly from Kallon Industries in the Federated Suns. Relations with House Davion remained strained from recent hostilities, however, and it was believed unlikely that the Alliance could secure the design. The attempt to obtain the Partisan through diplomatic channels failed, but it confirmed the design's reputation as the benchmark for dedicated anti-aircraft vehicles.

Instead, Snow Raven engineers partnered with their Outworlder counterparts at the United Outworlders Corporation on Mitchella. The collaboration divided responsibilities along each partner's strengths: the Ravens supplied engineering expertise, electronics, weapons, and armor technology, while the Outworlders provided manufacturing capacity, chassis production, and the fuel cell engine. The result was the Nuberu, named for the Asturian cloud spirit, a vehicle that used Clan technology to improve upon the Partisan concept while costing less than two-thirds of a comparable Partisan Air Defense Tank.

The Nuberu's innovative twin-turret design set it apart from every other vehicle in the Partisan lineage. By splitting its four Clan-grade LB 5-X autocannons between two independent mounts, the vehicle could continue fighting with half its firepower even after losing a turret. This redundancy was particularly valued by garrison commanders who could not count on rapid reinforcement. Clan laser-reflective armor provided exceptional protection against the energy weapons typical of pirate and bandit aerospace fighters, the most common airborne threat in Raven Alliance space.

Only in production since 3083, the Nuberu has proliferated rapidly across the Alliance. Every Raven garrison carries at least two platoons, with many possessing a full company or more. Deployments to defend significant installations have allowed far more fighters and BattleMechs to be released from static defensive duties. Most Raven enclaves maintain two Stars of the tank, often split into sub-units of two or more Points for distributed coverage. An entire Cluster of Nuberus has been observed on Alpheratz, defending the construction site of the Raven Alliance's new capital enclave.

The Numantia support variant, mounting Streak SRM 6s and LRM 15 launchers in place of the standard autocannons, addressed the base model's lack of secondary weapons. Deployed at a rate of one to two per platoon, the Numantia provides anti-infantry capability and indirect fire support that complements the standard model's dedicated anti-aircraft role.

The Nuberu is a significant milestone in the Partisan legacy. For nearly three centuries, the Partisan family had been exclusively an Inner Sphere design, produced by Kallon Industries for the armies of the Successor States. The Nuberu broke that monopoly, demonstrating that the mobile air defense doctrine the Partisan had pioneered was valuable enough to inspire independent development on the Periphery. Together with the Combine's Nike Air Defense Platform, the Nuberu confirmed that the Partisan's greatest contribution was not any single vehicle but the concept of dedicated, mobile, ground-based air defense itself.
